documentation_check.method: raw HTML of the official pages fetched with curl and read directly, not through a summary
verified: OpenAI-format base URL https://api.deepseek.com, chat completions endpoint
model 'deepseek-flash' is served by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; 'deepseek-v4-pro' is the other current model
thinking {type: enabled|disabled}, default enabled, so non-thinking mode is requested explicitly
temperature <= 2 (default 1); top_p <= 1 (default 1); the docs advise changing one of them, not both
response_format {type: json_object} enables JSON output; the prompt must contain the word json and an example; the API may occasionally return empty content
max_tokens bounds generated tokens; finish_reason 'length' marks truncation
deepseek-flash prices per 1M tokens: input cache hit 0.003 off-peak / 0.006 peak, cache miss 0.15 / 0.30, output 0.60 / 1.20
documentation_check.not_found: no API control for provider-side retention of prompts or outputs; the evidence sent is public headlines and stored feed excerpts

retry_policy: one initial generation; one retry only if the output does not parse into schema v1, with the parser error shown. No retry for wrong, weak, incomplete or abstaining answers. Transport retries (at most 2) re-send a request only when no response was received.

schema.limitations: 0 to 3, at most 300 characters, reviewed for uncited facts
schema.urls: never produced by the model; resolved from the store

context_serializer.truncation: headline first 300 characters, excerpt first 500 characters

pre_generation_validation: every context item passes the question's filters
frozen retriever code and index unchanged
empty context: deterministic system abstention, no provider call
post_generation_validation: citation membership in the supplied context
every claim and the summary cite
provenance: every citation resolves to its stored URL

claim_support.applies_to: the summary and each claim of answers that passed validation

context_sufficiency.question: Does the supplied context hold enough evidence to answer?

limitations.question: Do the limitations add an uncited factual claim?

human_rubric.unsure: never counted as unsupported or incorrect; reported separately

metrics.claim_support_precision: SUPPORTED / (SUPPORTED + UNSUPPORTED) over reviewed claims and summaries; UNSURE reported separately
metrics.grounded_answer_rate: over evaluable model outputs (answered, model abstention, rejected). An output is evaluable unless its context_sufficiency or abstention judgment is UNSURE or missing. Grounded when: deterministic validation passed; no claim or summary is UNSUPPORTED; and it is not an INCORRECT abstention and not an answer judged INSUFFICIENT while context_sufficiency is YES. Rejected outputs count as not grounded. System abstentions are reported separately
metrics.abstention: correct = model abstention judged CORRECT; incorrect = judged INCORRECT; missed = answered while context_sufficiency is NO. precision = correct / (correct + incorrect); recall = correct / (correct + missed)

failure_taxonomy.RETRIEVAL_MISS: required evidence never entered the context (from EXP-004 DEV gold where available)
failure_taxonomy.GENERATION_OMISSION: evidence in the context was not used (completeness PARTIAL or INSUFFICIENT)
failure_taxonomy.CITATION_MISMATCH: an allowed item cited for another claim or topic (human note)
failure_taxonomy.FABRICATED_CITATION: an item not in the context (validator)
failure_taxonomy.OVERSTATEMENT: evidence supports a weaker statement (human note)
failure_taxonomy.MISSED_ABSTENTION: answered while context sufficiency is NO
failure_taxonomy.SCHEMA_FAILURE: output rejected by schema v1 after the retry
failure_taxonomy.extension_rule: new categories only as explicitly post-hoc extensions

development_set: EXP-004 DEV questions (37). EXP-004 TEST questions are never used: they were inspected descriptively and are not a pristine generation test. A fresh generation holdout is authored, owner-reviewed and frozen before final evaluation.
